name: Question 4
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/7bc92d6714fa6219053b05f8ae6a5f601a6008bf4cdd9178a573aea2905db227.png)

What division problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{3}{5}$ on the left and $\frac{3}{10}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/25a7161ff1f5394b8a807aa49f0abfdccca30f90caf799146fb848cf3ef35f5d.png)

Therefore, the division problem shown is

$$
\frac{3}{5}÷2=\frac{3}{10}.
$$
